content.title: Empresa: Q2 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: BUENOS AIRES, Argentina (AP) — Empresa Distribuidora y Comercializadora Norte S.A. (EDN) on Monday reported profit of $81.1 million in its second quarter. The Buenos Aires, Argentina-based company said it had profit of $1.85 per share. The electric power distributor posted revenue of $543.7 million in the period.
